Neural SDF Training with Point Cloud and Eikonal Regularization

definition: Trains a signed distance function (SDF) network using point cloud data and Eikonal regularization to enforce unit gradient magnitude.
summary: SDF Training with Eikonal Loss optimizes a neural implicit Signed Distance Field to match 3D point cloud data by enforcing the Eikonal equation constraint for geometric consistency.
